    page.select_option(SEL_TOPICS_PRIORITY, 'high')
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_selector(TOPIC_A), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count() == 1, '新增选题后列表数量应 0 -> 1')
    report.check(page.locator(topic_selector(TOPIC_A)).count() == 1, '新选题应以 topics-item 出现在 topics-list 中')
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '新增成功后不应显示 error-text')
    report.step('A009 新增选题', '列表数量 0 -> 1')

    # --- A010 内容角度可为空、优先级默认「中」 -------------------------------
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT, TOPIC_B)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT, '')
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_selector(TOPIC_B), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count() == 2, '新增第二个选题后列表数量应为 2')
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '内容角度留空也应保存成功')
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_B)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT) == '', '内容角度留空的选题打开时角度应为空')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_PRIORITY) == 'medium', '优先级保持默认时应为 medium')
    report.step('A010/A011 默认值与可空字段', '角度为空、优先级 medium')

    # --- A012 查看已有选题 --------------------------------------------------
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_A)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT) == TOPIC_A, '打开选题应预填标题')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT) == TOPIC_A_ANGLE, '打开选题应预填内容角度')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_PRIORITY) == 'high', '打开选题应预填优先级')
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_LINKED).count() == 0, '尚未关联素材时关联列表应为空')
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_CHECKBOX).count() > 0, '编辑界面应提供素材勾选项')
    report.step('A012 查看选题', '三个字段预填且可看到关联素材区域')

    # --- A013 编辑选题 ------------------------------------------------------
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT, TOPIC_A_EDITED)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT, TOPIC_A_ANGLE_EDITED)
    page.select_option(SEL_TOPICS_PRIORITY, 'low')
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_selector(TOPIC_A_EDITED), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(topic_selector(TOPIC_A)).count() == 0, '列表中该条的 data-topic-title 应显示新标题')
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_A_EDITED)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT) == TOPIC_A_EDITED, '重新打开应看到修改后的标题')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT) == TOPIC_A_ANGLE_EDITED, '重新打开应看到修改后的内容角度')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_PRIORITY) == 'low', '重新打开应看到修改后的优先级')
    report.step('A013 编辑选题', '标题／内容角度／优先级修改后可见')

    # --- A014/A016 关联与解除关联素材 --------------------------------------
    report.check(
        page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(material_id)).count() == 1,
        '编辑界面应存在指向素材库素材的 topics-material-checkbox',
    )
    page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(material_id)).check()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_linked_selector(material_id), timeout=5000)
    report.check(
        page.locator(topic_linked_selector(material_id)).count() == 1,
        '关联并保存后该选题的 topics-linked-material 应包含该素材',
    )
    report.step('A014 关联素材', '话题 %s 关联素材 %s' % (TOPIC_A_EDITED, material_id))

    page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(material_id)).uncheck()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_linked_selector(material_id), state='detached', timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(topic_linked_selector(material_id)).count() == 0, '解除关联后该素材应消失')
    goto_materials(page)
    report.check(
        page.locator(item_selector(material_id)).count() == 1,
        '解除关联后素材本身仍应留在素材库 materials-list 中',
    )
    goto_topics(page)
    report.step('A016 解除关联素材', '关联消失且素材保留')

    # --- A015 多对多关联 ----------------------------------------------------
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_B)
    page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(material_id)).check()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_linked_selector(material_id), timeout=5000)
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_A_EDITED)
    page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(material_id)).check()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_linked_selector(material_id), timeout=5000)

    open_topic(page, TOPIC_B)
    report.check(page.locator(topic_linked_selector(material_id)).count() == 1, '第一个选题应看到该素材')
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_A_EDITED)
    report.check(page.locator(topic_linked_selector(material_id)).count() == 1, '第二个选题应看到该素材')

    open_topic(page, TOPIC_B)
    page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(material_id)).uncheck()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_linked_selector(material_id), state='detached', timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(topic_linked_selector(material_id)).count() == 0, '被解除的选题不应再看到该素材')
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_A_EDITED)
    report.check(page.locator(topic_linked_selector(material_id)).count() == 1, '另一条选题的关联应保持不变')
    report.step('A015 多对多关联', '同一素材关联两个选题并单独解除')

    # --- A017 删除未建任务的选题不弹确认 ------------------------------------
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT, TOPIC_C)
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_selector(TOPIC_C), timeout=5000)
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_C)
    page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(material_id)).check()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_linked_selector(material_id), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(topic_selector(TOPIC_C)).count() == 1, '临时选题应已建立素材关联')

    count_before = page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count()
    tasks_before = page.evaluate("() => localStorage.getItem('%s')" % TASKS_STORAGE_KEY)
    dialogs_before = len(dialogs)
    page.locator(topic_child(TOPIC_C, SEL_TOPICS_DELETE)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_selector(TOPIC_C), state='detached', timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count() == count_before - 1, '删除后该选题应从 topics-list 消失')
    report.check(len(dialogs) == dialogs_before, '删除未建任务的选题不应出现浏览器原生 confirm 对话框')
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_CONFIRM_DIALOG).count() == 0, '不应出现 confirm-dialog 元素')
    report.check(topic_titles(page).count(TOPIC_C) == 0, '被删选题不应残留在列表中')
    tasks_after = page.evaluate("() => localStorage.getItem('%s')" % TASKS_STORAGE_KEY)
    report.check(tasks_after == tasks_before, '内容任务集合不应发生变化，实际 %r -> %r' % (tasks_before, tasks_after))

    goto_materials(page)
    report.check(page.locator(item_selector(material_id)).count() == 1, '被关联素材仍应出现在素材库中')
    goto_topics(page)
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_B)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT) == TOPIC_B, '其他选题仍可正常打开')
    report.step('A017 删除未建任务选题', '无确认、选题与关联消失、素材保留')

    # --- A045/A046 标题必填失败并保留已填内容，补标题后保存成功 -------------
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT, KEPT_ANGLE)
    count_before = page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    report.check(page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '标题留空保存应显示 error-text 提示')
    report.check('标题' in page.inner_text(SEL_ERROR), '错误提示应说明标题必填')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT) == KEPT_ANGLE, '保存失败后已填的内容角度应保留')
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count() == count_before, '保存失败不应新增选题')
    empty_titled = page.locator('%s[%s=""]' % (SEL_TOPICS_ITEM, TOPIC_TITLE_ATTR)).count()
    report.check(empty_titled == 0, '列表中不应出现空标题选题')
    report.step('A045 选题标题必填', '失败提示出现且已填角度保留')

    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT, RECOVERED_TOPIC)
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_selector(RECOVERED_TOPIC), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count() == count_before + 1, '补上标题后应保存成功并出现在列表中')
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '保存成功后不应再显示错误提示')
    report.step('A046 失败后补标题', '列表数量 %d -> %d' % (count_before, count_before + 1))

    # 完成后删除该临时选题（无关联素材、无任务，不弹确认）
    dialogs_before = len(dialogs)
    page.locator(topic_child(RECOVERED_TOPIC, SEL_TOPICS_DELETE)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_selector(RECOVERED_TOPIC), state='detached', timeout=5000)
    report.check(len(dialogs) == dialogs_before, '删除临时选题同样不应出现确认')
    report.step('清理临时选题', '无确认删除完成')


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 内容任务与工作台页面流程（A021–A038、A047、A048）。
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def tasks_flow(page, report):
    # --- 准备：一个已关联素材的选题（任务详情的来源侧数据） ------------------
    goto_topics(page)
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT, TOPIC_FOR_TASK)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT, TOPIC_FOR_TASK_ANGLE)
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_selector(TOPIC_FOR_TASK), timeout=5000)

    materials = storage_json(page, MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY)
    report.check(len(materials) > 0, '素材库应存在可关联素材')
    material_id = materials[-1]['id'] if materials else ''
    topic = find_record(
        storage_json(page, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY),
        lambda record: record.get('title') == TOPIC_FOR_TASK,
    )
    report.check(topic is not None, '应能读取新建的内容任务选题')
    topic_id = topic['id'] if topic else ''

    open_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_TASK)
    page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(material_id)).check()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_linked_selector(material_id), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(topic_linked_selector(material_id)).count() == 1, '来源选题应关联该素材')

    tasks_before = storage_json(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY)

    # --- A021/A023 从选题创建内容任务并进入该任务详情 ----------------------
    page.locator(topic_child(TOPIC_FOR_TASK, SEL_TOPICS_CREATE_TASK)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    after_create = storage_json(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY)
    report.check(
        len(after_create) == len(tasks_before) + 1,
        '从选题创建任务应只新增 1 个任务，实际 %d -> %d' % (len(tasks_before), len(after_create)),
    )
    created = find_record(after_create, lambda record: record.get('sourceTopicId') == topic_id)
    report.check(created is not None, '新任务应记录它的来源选题')
    task_id = created['id'] if created else ''
    report.check(
        page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_TITLE).strip() == TOPIC_FOR_TASK,
        '任务详情标题应等于来源选题标题，实际 %r' % page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_TITLE),
    )
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_TITLE_INPUT) == TOPIC_FOR_TASK, '任务标题输入应复制来源选题标题')
    report.check(
        page.inner_text(SEL_VIEW_TITLE).strip() == VIEW_TITLE_TASK_DETAIL,
        '视图标题应为 %s，实际 %r' % (VIEW_TITLE_TASK_DETAIL, page.inner_text(SEL_VIEW_TITLE)),
    )
    report.step('A021/A023 从选题创建任务', '任务标题复制自选题 %r' % TOPIC_FOR_TASK)

    # --- A025 任务详情展示完整数据、来源选题与关联素材 ----------------------
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT) == '', '新任务的草稿应为空')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT) == '', '无截止日期时 task-due-input 应为空')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT) == 'todo', '新任务状态应为待写作')
    options = page.locator(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT + ' option').evaluate_all(
        'els => els.map(el => el.value)'
    )
    report.check(options == WORKBENCH_STATUSES, '状态应为四态选项，实际 %r' % (options,))
    report.check(
        page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_TOPIC_TITLE).strip() == TOPIC_FOR_TASK,
        '应显示来源选题标题，实际 %r' % page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_TOPIC_TITLE),
    )
    linked = page.locator(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_MATERIAL_ITEM).evaluate_all(
        "els => els.map(el => el.getAttribute('data-material-id'))"
    )
    report.check(
        linked == [material_id],
        '来源素材列表应与素材库中同一条素材一致，实际 %r' % (linked,),
    )
    report.step('A025 任务详情展示', '标题／草稿／截止日期／状态／来源选题／关联素材')

    # --- A022 重复创建进入同一个任务且任务总数不增加 ------------------------
    open_task_from_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_TASK)
    report.check(
        page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_TITLE).strip() == TOPIC_FOR_TASK,
        '对已建任务的选题再次创建应进入同一个任务',
    )
    report.check(
        len(storage_json(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY)) == len(tasks_before) + 1,
        '重复创建不应产生第二个任务',
    )
    report.step('A022 重复创建', '任务总数保持 %d' % (len(tasks_before) + 1))

    # --- A026/A027 编辑草稿与截止日期后重新打开 -----------------------------
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT, DRAFT_TEXT)
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT, FUTURE_DUE_DATE)
    report.check(
        page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT) == FUTURE_DUE_DATE,
        '截止日期输入应接受 %s' % FUTURE_DUE_DATE,
    )
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '保存草稿与截止日期不应出现错误提示')

    goto_workbench(page)
    item = page.locator(workbench_item_selector(SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_ITEM, task_id))
    report.check(item.count() == 1, '未完成任务应包含该任务及其 data-task-id')
    if item.count() == 1:
        item_title = item.get_attribute(TASK_TITLE_ATTR)
        item.click()
        page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
        report.check(
            page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_TITLE).strip() == item_title,
            '从工作台条目进入的任务详情标题应与 data-task-title 一致',
        )
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT) == DRAFT_TEXT, '重新打开应看到修改后的草稿')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT) == FUTURE_DUE_DATE, '重新打开应看到设置的截止日期')
    report.step('A026/A027 编辑草稿与截止日期', '草稿与截止日期保存后可重放')

    # --- A024 任务标题与来源选题标题相互独立 --------------------------------
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_TITLE_INPUT, TASK_TITLE_FINAL)
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    report.check(
        page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_TITLE).strip() == TASK_TITLE_FINAL,
        '任务详情应显示新标题，实际 %r' % page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_TITLE),
    )
    goto_topics(page)
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_TASK)
    report.check(
        page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT) == TOPIC_FOR_TASK,
        '来源选题标题不应随任务标题改变，实际 %r' % page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT),
    )
    goto_workbench(page)
    item = page.locator(workbench_item_selector(SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_ITEM, task_id))
    report.check(item.count() == 1, '未完成任务应仍包含该任务')
    if item.count() == 1:
        report.check(
            item.get_attribute(TASK_TITLE_ATTR) == TASK_TITLE_FINAL,
            '工作台条目的 data-task-title 应显示任务新标题',
        )
    report.step('A024 标题独立', '任务标题 %r，来源选题标题保持 %r' % (TASK_TITLE_FINAL, TOPIC_FOR_TASK))

    # --- A028/A029 四态切换（含从已发布回退） -------------------------------
    open_task_from_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_TASK)
    page.select_option(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT, 'writing')
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    open_task_from_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_TASK)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT) == 'writing', '状态应保存为写作中')

    page.select_option(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT, 'published')
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    open_task_from_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_TASK)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT) == 'published', '状态应保存为已发布')

    page.select_option(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT, 'writing')
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '允许从已发布回退，保存不应报错')
    open_task_from_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_TASK)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT) == 'writing', '回退后状态应为写作中')
    options = page.locator(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT + ' option').evaluate_all(
        'els => els.map(el => el.value)'
    )
    report.check(options == WORKBENCH_STATUSES, '已发布回退后四态仍均可选，实际 %r' % (options,))
    report.step('A028/A029 状态切换', 'todo→writing→published→writing')

    # --- A047/A048 标题必填失败保留草稿，恢复标题后保存成功 ------------------
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_TITLE_INPUT, '')
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT, KEPT_DRAFT)
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    report.check(page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '清空标题保存应显示 error-text 提示')
    report.check('标题' in page.inner_text(SEL_ERROR), '错误提示应说明标题必填')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT) == KEPT_DRAFT, '保存失败后已填草稿应保留')
    report.check(
        page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_TITLE).strip() == TASK_TITLE_FINAL,
        '任务标题不应被改为空',
    )
    stored = find_record(storage_json(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY), lambda record: record.get('id') == task_id)
    report.check(stored is not None and stored.get('title') == TASK_TITLE_FINAL, '失败的保存不应改写任务标题')
    report.check(stored is not None and stored.get('draft') == DRAFT_TEXT, '失败的保存不应写入草稿')
    open_task_from_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_TASK)
    report.check(
        page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_TITLE).strip() == TASK_TITLE_FINAL,
        '重新打开该任务时标题仍是原标题',
    )
    report.step('A047 标题必填', '失败提示出现且草稿保留')

    page.fill(SEL_TASK_TITLE_INPUT, TASK_TITLE_FINAL)
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT, DRAFT_TEXT)
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '恢复标题后保存成功且提示消失')
    report.check(
        page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_TITLE).strip() == TASK_TITLE_FINAL,
        '补回标题后任务详情显示该标题',
    )
    report.step('A048 恢复标题', '保存成功且错误提示消失')

    # --- 第二个任务：用于逾期与四状态计数核对 -------------------------------
    goto_topics(page)
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT, TOPIC_OVERDUE)
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_selector(TOPIC_OVERDUE), timeout=5000)
    overdue_topic = find_record(
        storage_json(page, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY),
        lambda record: record.get('title') == TOPIC_OVERDUE,
    )
    report.check(overdue_topic is not None, '应能读取第二个选题')
    overdue_topic_id = overdue_topic['id'] if overdue_topic else ''

    page.locator(topic_child(TOPIC_OVERDUE, SEL_TOPICS_CREATE_TASK)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    overdue_task = find_record(
        storage_json(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY),
        lambda record: record.get('sourceTopicId') == overdue_topic_id,
    )
    report.check(overdue_task is not None, '第二个选题应创建自己的任务')
    overdue_task_id = overdue_task['id'] if overdue_task else ''
    report.check(overdue_task_id not in ('', task_id), '两个选题的任务应各自独立')
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT, OVERDUE_DUE_DATE)
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    report.check(
        page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT) == OVERDUE_DUE_DATE,
        '第二个任务应保存早于当天的截止日期',
    )

    # --- A030/A031/A035 工作台未完成／逾期条目与四状态计数 ------------------
    goto_workbench(page)
    today, tasks, unfinished, overdue = check_workbench(page, report, 'A030/A031/A035 工作台统计')
    overdue_ids = item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_ITEM)
    report.check(overdue_task_id in overdue_ids, '截止日期早于当天的任务应出现在逾期条目')
    report.check(task_id not in overdue_ids, '截止日期晚于当天的任务不应计入逾期')
    report.check(all(task.get('dueDate') for task in overdue), '逾期任务都应有截止日期')

    # --- A032 清空截止日期：不计入逾期且未完成计数不变 ----------------------
    unfinished_before = shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_COUNT)
    page.locator(workbench_item_selector(SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_ITEM, overdue_task_id)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    page.click(SEL_TASK_DUE_CLEAR)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT) == '', '清空截止日期后 task-due-input 应为空')
    goto_workbench(page)
    check_workbench(page, report, 'A032 清空截止日期')
    report.check(
        overdue_task_id not in item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_ITEM),
        '无截止日期的任务不应出现在逾期条目',
    )
    report.check(
        shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_COUNT) == unfinished_before,
        '清空截止日期不应改变未完成计数',
    )
    report.step('A032 清空截止日期', '任务不再计入逾期')

    # --- A033 截止日期等于本地当天：不算逾期 -------------------------------
    page.locator(workbench_item_selector(SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_ITEM, overdue_task_id)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT, today)
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    goto_workbench(page)
    check_workbench(page, report, 'A033 当天不算逾期')
    report.check(
        overdue_task_id not in item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_ITEM),
        '截止日期等于本地当天的任务不应计入逾期，实际 %r' % (item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_ITEM),),
    )
    report.check(
        shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_COUNT) == unfinished_before,
        '截止日期设为当天不应改变未完成计数',
    )
    report.step('A033 当天不算逾期', '截止日期等于 %s 的任务仍在未完成中' % today)

    # --- A034 逾期任务改为已发布：从工作台未完成与逾期条目移除 --------------
    page.locator(workbench_item_selector(SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_ITEM, overdue_task_id)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT, OVERDUE_DUE_DATE)
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    goto_workbench(page)
    report.check(
        overdue_task_id in item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_ITEM),
        '恢复为过期截止日期后应重新计入逾期',
    )

    page.locator(workbench_item_selector(SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_ITEM, overdue_task_id)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    page.select_option(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT, 'published')
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    goto_workbench(page)
    check_workbench(page, report, 'A034 已发布移出工作台')
    report.check(
        overdue_task_id not in item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_ITEM),
        '已发布任务应从未完成条目移除',
    )
    report.check(
        overdue_task_id not in item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_ITEM),
        '已发布任务应从逾期条目移除',
    )
    report.step('A034 已发布', '任务从工作台未完成与逾期条目移除')

    # --- A037 从工作台点击条目进入任务详情 ---------------------------------
    item = page.locator(workbench_item_selector(SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_ITEM, task_id))
    report.check(item.count() == 1, '未完成任务应包含第一个任务')
    if item.count() == 1:
        expected_title = item.get_attribute(TASK_TITLE_ATTR)
        item.click()
        page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
        report.check(
            page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_TITLE).strip() == expected_title,
            '从工作台条目进入的任务详情标题应与该条目 data-task-title 一致',
        )
        report.check(
            page.locator(SEL_WORKBENCH_VIEW).count() == 0,
            '进入任务详情后应已离开工作台视图',
        )
    report.step('A037 从工作台进入详情', '任务 %s' % task_id)

    # --- A038 刷新页面后数据与工作台计数保留 -------------------------------
    goto_workbench(page)
    before_counts = {status: shown_count(page, status_count_selector(status)) for status in WORKBENCH_STATUSES}
    before_unfinished = shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_COUNT)
    before_overdue = shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_COUNT)
    page.reload(wait_until='load')
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_MATERIALS_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    report.check(len(storage_json(page, MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY)) >= 1, '刷新后素材数据仍存在')
    report.check(len(storage_json(page, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY)) >= 1, '刷新后选题数据仍存在')
    report.check(len(storage_json(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY)) >= 2, '刷新后内容任务数据仍存在')

    goto_workbench(page)
    check_workbench(page, report, 'A038 刷新后工作台')
    report.check(
        shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_COUNT) == before_unfinished,
        '刷新后未完成计数应与刷新前一致',
    )
    report.check(
        shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_COUNT) == before_overdue,
        '刷新后逾期计数应与刷新前一致',
    )
    for status in WORKBENCH_STATUSES:
        report.check(
            shown_count(page, status_count_selector(status)) == before_counts[status],
            '刷新后 %s 状态计数应与刷新前一致' % status,
        )

    page.locator(workbench_item_selector(SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_ITEM, task_id)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_TITLE_INPUT) == TASK_TITLE_FINAL, '刷新后任务标题应为刷新前保存的值')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT) == DRAFT_TEXT, '刷新后草稿应为刷新前保存的值')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT) == FUTURE_DUE_DATE, '刷新后截止日期应为刷新前保存的值')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT) == 'writing', '刷新后状态应为刷新前保存的值')
    report.step('A038 刷新保留', '数据与工作台计数刷新后一致')


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 素材删除与「删除已创建任务的选题被阻止」流程（A018–A020、A040–A042、A049、A050）。
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def material_delete_button(page, material_id):
    return page.locator(item_selector(material_id)).locator(SEL_MATERIALS_DELETE)


def material_titles(page):
    return page.locator(SEL_ITEM).evaluate_all(
        "els => els.map(el => el.getAttribute('data-material-title'))"
    )


def material_view_data(page):
    '''页面上每条素材当前的标题、来源链接与笔记文本（用于比较内容是否被改动）。'''
    return page.locator(SEL_ITEM).evaluate_all(
        "els => els.map(el => {"
        " const link = el.querySelector(\"a[data-testid='materials-source-link']\");"
        " const note = el.querySelector(\"[data-testid='material-note']\");"
        " return { title: el.getAttribute('data-material-title'),"
        " href: link ? link.getAttribute('href') : '',"
        " note: note ? note.textContent : '' }; })"
    )


def topic_linked_ids(page):
    return page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_LINKED).evaluate_all(
        "els => els.map(el => el.getAttribute('data-material-id'))"
    )


def collection_raw(page, key):
    '''集合的原始持久化文本，用于断言被阻止／取消的操作零写入。'''
    return page.evaluate("(k) => localStorage.getItem(k)", key)


def task_field_values(page):
    return {
        'title': page.input_value(SEL_TASK_TITLE_INPUT),
        'draft': page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT),
        'status': page.input_value(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT),
        'due': page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT),
    }


def blocked_reason(page):
    parts = []
    if page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR):
        parts.append(page.inner_text(SEL_ERROR))
    if page.is_visible(SEL_NOTICE):
        parts.append(page.inner_text(SEL_NOTICE))
    return ' '.join(part.strip() for part in parts).strip()


def workbench_counts(page):
    return {
        'unfinished': shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_COUNT),
        'overdue': shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_COUNT),
        'statuses': {
            status: shown_count(page, status_count_selector(status)) for status in WORKBENCH_STATUSES
        },
    }


def in_page_dialog_message(page):
    '''页面内影响提示（confirm-dialog／confirm-message）的文本；不存在时返回 None。'''
    if page.locator(SEL_CONFIRM_DIALOG).count() != 1:
        return None
    message = page.locator(SEL_CONFIRM_MESSAGE)
    if message.count() == 1:
        return message.inner_text()
    return page.inner_text(SEL_CONFIRM_DIALOG)


def click_in_page_dialog_button(page, label):
    page.locator("%s button:has-text('%s')" % (SEL_CONFIRM_DIALOG, label)).first.click()


def delete_and_block_flow(page, report, dialogs, dialog_state):
    '''删除素材（无关联／有关联的取消与确认）与删除有任务选题被阻止的真实页面操作。'''
    # --- 准备：两个素材 + 一个同时关联两者并已建任务的选题 ---
    goto_materials(page)
    materials_count = page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()
    for title in (MATERIAL_DOOMED, MATERIAL_KEPT):
        page.click(SEL_NEW)
        page.fill(SEL_TITLE_INPUT, title)
        page.click(SEL_SAVE)
        page.wait_for_selector(item_selector_by_title(title), timeout=5000)
    report.check(
        page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count() == materials_count + 2,
        '准备两个素材后列表数量应 %d -> %d，实际 %d' % (materials_count, materials_count + 2, page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()),
    )
    records = storage_json(page, MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY)
    doomed = find_record(records, lambda record: record.get('title') == MATERIAL_DOOMED)
    kept = find_record(records, lambda record: record.get('title') == MATERIAL_KEPT)
    report.check(doomed is not None and kept is not None, '应能读取准备的两个素材')
    doomed_id = doomed['id'] if doomed else ''
    kept_id = kept['id'] if kept else ''

    # --- A020 删除未关联任何选题的素材：不出现任何确认 ---
    materials_count = page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()
    page.click(SEL_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TITLE_INPUT, MATERIAL_UNLINKED)
    page.click(SEL_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(item_selector_by_title(MATERIAL_UNLINKED), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count() == materials_count + 1, '新增临时素材后列表数量应 +1')
    unlinked = find_record(
        storage_json(page, MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY),
        lambda record: record.get('title') == MATERIAL_UNLINKED,
    )
    report.check(unlinked is not None, '应能读取临时未关联素材')
    unlinked_id = unlinked['id'] if unlinked else ''

    dialogs_before = len(dialogs)
    materials_count = page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()
    material_delete_button(page, unlinked_id).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(item_selector(unlinked_id), state='detached', timeout=5000)
    report.check(
        page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count() == materials_count - 1,
        '删除未关联素材后列表数量应 %d -> %d' % (materials_count, materials_count - 1),
    )
    report.check(len(dialogs) == dialogs_before, '删除未关联素材不应出现浏览器原生 confirm 对话框')
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_CONFIRM_DIALOG).count() == 0, '删除未关联素材不应出现 confirm-dialog 元素')
    report.check(page.locator(item_selector(doomed_id)).count() == 1, '其他素材应保留在 materials-list 中')
    report.check(page.locator(item_selector(kept_id)).count() == 1, '其他素材应保留在 materials-list 中')
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '删除未关联素材不应显示错误提示')
    report.step('A020 删除未关联素材', '未出现任何确认，该素材直接消失且其他素材保留')

    # --- 准备：关联两个素材的选题与从它创建的内容任务 ---
    goto_topics(page)
    topics_count = page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT, TOPIC_FOR_DELETE)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT, TOPIC_FOR_DELETE_ANGLE)
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_selector(TOPIC_FOR_DELETE), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count() == topics_count + 1, '新增影响选题后列表数量应 +1')
    topic_record = find_record(
        storage_json(page, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY),
        lambda record: record.get('title') == TOPIC_FOR_DELETE,
    )
    report.check(topic_record is not None, '应能读取删除素材影响选题')
    topic_id = topic_record['id'] if topic_record else ''

    open_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_DELETE)
    page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(doomed_id)).check()
    page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(kept_id)).check()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(topic_linked_selector(doomed_id), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(topic_linked_selector(kept_id)).count() == 1, '该选题应关联两个素材')

    page.locator(topic_child(TOPIC_FOR_DELETE, SEL_TOPICS_CREATE_TASK)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    task_record = find_record(
        storage_json(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY),
        lambda record: record.get('sourceTopicId') == topic_id,
    )
    report.check(task_record is not None, '影响选题应能创建内容任务')
    task_id = task_record['id'] if task_record else ''
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT, DELETE_FLOW_DRAFT)
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT, FUTURE_DUE_DATE)
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '保存该任务草稿与截止日期不应报错')

    # --- A040/A042 删除已关联素材：先出现影响提示，取消后零变化 ---
    goto_materials(page)
    titles_before = material_titles(page)
    materials_count = page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()
    tasks_raw = collection_raw(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY)
    topics_raw = collection_raw(page, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY)
    goto_workbench(page)
    counts_before = workbench_counts(page)
    goto_topics(page)
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_DELETE)
    report.check(
        sorted(topic_linked_ids(page)) == sorted([doomed_id, kept_id]),
        '取消前该选题应关联两个素材，实际 %r' % (topic_linked_ids(page),),
    )

    goto_materials(page)
    dialogs_before = len(dialogs)
    dialog_state['mode'] = 'dismiss'
    material_delete_button(page, doomed_id).click()
    native_message = dialogs[-1] if len(dialogs) > dialogs_before else ''
    page_message = in_page_dialog_message(page)
    report.check(
        native_message != '' or page_message is not None,
        '删除已关联素材应出现影响提示（浏览器原生确认对话框或页面内 confirm-dialog）',
    )
    hint_text = native_message if native_message else (page_message or '')
    report.check(MATERIAL_DOOMED in hint_text, '影响提示应包含将被删除的素材标题，实际 %r' % (hint_text,))
    report.check(TOPIC_FOR_DELETE in hint_text, '影响提示应包含受影响选题标题，实际 %r' % (hint_text,))
    report.step('A040 影响提示', '提示包含素材标题与受影响选题标题')

    if native_message == '' and page_message is not None:
        click_in_page_dialog_button(page, '取消')
    report.check(page.locator(item_selector(doomed_id)).count() == 1, '取消后该素材仍出现在 materials-list 中')
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count() == materials_count, '取消后素材数量不变')
    report.check(material_titles(page) == titles_before, '取消后素材库列表不变')
    report.check(collection_raw(page, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY) == topics_raw, '取消后素材关联应完全相同')
    report.check(collection_raw(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY) == tasks_raw, '取消后任务集合应完全相同')
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '取消不应被渲染为失败提示')
    goto_topics(page)
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_DELETE)
    report.check(
        sorted(topic_linked_ids(page)) == sorted([doomed_id, kept_id]),
        '取消后该素材与选题的关联仍未改变',
    )
    goto_workbench(page)
    report.check(workbench_counts(page) == counts_before, '取消后工作台未完成／逾期／四状态计数与取消前一致')
    report.step('A042 取消删除', '素材／关联／任务与工作台计数零变化')

    # --- A041/A049 确认删除：级联清理关联、保留选题，任务详情仍显示来源选题与当前素材 ---
    goto_materials(page)
    dialogs_before = len(dialogs)
    dialog_state['mode'] = 'accept'
    materials_count = page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()
    material_delete_button(page, doomed_id).click()
    if len(dialogs) == dialogs_before:
        click_in_page_dialog_button(page, '确认')
    page.wait_for_selector(item_selector(doomed_id), state='detached', timeout=5000)
    report.check(
        page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count() == materials_count - 1,
        '确认后该素材应从 materials-list 消失，数量 %d -> %d' % (materials_count, materials_count - 1),
    )
    report.check(
        find_record(storage_json(page, MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY), lambda record: record.get('id') == doomed_id) is None,
        '确认后素材记录应被删除',
    )
    goto_topics(page)
    report.check(page.locator(topic_selector(TOPIC_FOR_DELETE)).count() == 1, '被关联的选题应保留在 topics-list 中')
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_DELETE)
    report.check(topic_linked_ids(page) == [kept_id], '该素材在选题中的关联应被清理且只保留其他素材')
    report.check(
        page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT) == TOPIC_FOR_DELETE,
        '被关联的选题仍可正常打开',
    )
    report.step('A041 确认删除', '素材与全部关联被删除，相关选题保留')

    goto_workbench(page)
    item = page.locator(workbench_item_selector(SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_ITEM, task_id))
    report.check(item.count() == 1, '该任务应仍在工作台未完成条目中')
    if item.count() == 1:
        item.click()
    else:
        open_task_from_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_DELETE)
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_MATERIAL_ITEM, timeout=5000)
    report.check(
        page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_TOPIC_TITLE).strip() == TOPIC_FOR_DELETE,
        '删除素材后任务详情仍应显示来源选题标题，实际 %r' % page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_TOPIC_TITLE),
    )
    linked = page.locator(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_MATERIAL_ITEM).evaluate_all(
        "els => els.map(el => el.getAttribute('data-material-id'))"
    )
    report.check(
        linked == [kept_id],
        '来源素材列表应只保留该选题当前仍关联的素材（被删素材不再出现），实际 %r' % (linked,),
    )
    report.step('A049 删除后任务详情', '来源选题 %r 与当前关联素材 %r' % (TOPIC_FOR_DELETE, kept_id))

    # --- A018/A019 删除已创建内容任务的选题被阻止，随后三视图可用且数据不变 ---
    goto_workbench(page)
    counts_locked = workbench_counts(page)
    goto_topics(page)
    topics_count = page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count()
    materials_raw = collection_raw(page, MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY)
    topics_raw = collection_raw(page, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY)
    tasks_raw = collection_raw(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY)
    dialogs_before = len(dialogs)
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '阻止删除前不应有残留错误提示')
    page.locator(topic_child(TOPIC_FOR_DELETE, SEL_TOPICS_DELETE)).click()
    try:
        page.wait_for_selector(SEL_ERROR, state='visible', timeout=5000)
    except Exception:
        pass
    reason = blocked_reason(page)
    report.check(
        page.locator(topic_selector(TOPIC_FOR_DELETE)).count() == 1,
        '删除被阻止后该选题仍留在 topics-list 中',
    )
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count() == topics_count, '删除被阻止后选题数量不变')
    report.check(bool(reason), '删除被阻止后页面应显示说明原因的提示')
    report.check('任务' in reason or '关联' in reason, '提示应说明存在关联任务，实际 %r' % (reason,))
    report.check(len(dialogs) == dialogs_before, '删除被阻止不应出现任何确认')
    report.check(collection_raw(page, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY) == topics_raw, '被阻止的删除不应写入选题集合')
    report.check(collection_raw(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY) == tasks_raw, '被阻止的删除不应写入任务集合')
    report.check(collection_raw(page, MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY) == materials_raw, '被阻止的删除不应写入素材集合')
    report.step('A018 阻止删除', '选题保留且页面说明原因：%r' % (reason,))

    goto_materials(page)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_MATERIALS_VIEW).is_visible(), '删除被阻止后素材库视图应正常渲染')
    report.check(page.inner_text(SEL_VIEW_TITLE).strip() == VIEW_TITLE_MATERIALS, '素材库视图标题应正确')
    report.check(
        page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count() == len(storage_json(page, MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY)),
        '素材库可正常使用且素材数不变',
    )
    report.check(collection_raw(page, MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY) == materials_raw, '素材数据不变')

    goto_topics(page)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_VIEW).is_visible(), '删除被阻止后选题管理视图应正常渲染')
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_TOPICS_ITEM).count() == topics_count, '选题数不变')
    report.check(collection_raw(page, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY) == topics_raw, '选题数据不变')

    goto_workbench(page)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_WORKBENCH_VIEW).is_visible(), '删除被阻止后工作台视图应正常渲染')
    check_workbench(page, report, 'A019 阻止后工作台')
    report.check(workbench_counts(page) == counts_locked, '阻止后工作台未完成／逾期／四状态计数不变')
    report.check(collection_raw(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY) == tasks_raw, '任务数据不变')
    report.step('A019 阻止后各模块可用', '三视图正常渲染且素材／选题／任务数与工作台计数不变')

    # --- A050 编辑选题的内容角度与优先级不影响其他任务与其他素材 ---
    goto_topics(page)
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_OVERDUE)
    page.locator(topic_child(TOPIC_OVERDUE, SEL_TOPICS_CREATE_TASK)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    other_task_before = task_field_values(page)
    report.check(other_task_before['title'] == TOPIC_OVERDUE, '对照任务标题应等于其来源选题标题')

    goto_materials(page)
    material_data_before = material_view_data(page)

    goto_topics(page)
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_FOR_DELETE)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT, TOPIC_ANGLE_EDITED)
    page.select_option(SEL_TOPICS_PRIORITY, 'high')
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '编辑选题内容角度与优先级应保存成功')
    report.check(
        page.locator(topic_selector(TOPIC_FOR_DELETE)).count() == 1,
        '选题标题不变，仍以原标题出现在 topics-list 中',
    )
    report.check(topic_linked_ids(page) == [kept_id], '编辑后该选题原有的素材关联保持不变')
    report.step('A050 编辑选题', '内容角度与优先级改为 high 并保存成功')

    goto_topics(page)
    open_topic(page, TOPIC_OVERDUE)
    page.locator(topic_child(TOPIC_OVERDUE, SEL_TOPICS_CREATE_TASK)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    report.check(
        task_field_values(page) == other_task_before,
        '编辑选题不应改变其他任务的标题／草稿／状态／截止日期，实际 %r' % (task_field_values(page),),
    )

    goto_materials(page)
    report.check(
        material_view_data(page) == material_data_before,
        '编辑选题不应改变素材的标题、来源链接与笔记，实际 %r' % (material_view_data(page),),
    )
    report.step('A050 其他数据不变', '任务字段与素材内容保持不变')


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 持久化两阶段验证（A039）：重启本地服务后重新打开页面，已有素材、选题与任务及其数据仍然存在。
# 前阶段（--phase first）用固定 user_data_dir 的持久化上下文在传入 URL 上执行页面操作并落盘证据；
# 服务由 Worker 在两次运行之间重启；后阶段（--phase second）用同一 URL 与同一 user_data_dir 重新断言。
# 脚本只做 page.goto 与页面操作：不自建 HTTP 服务、不绑定端口、不使用 skip。
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DEFAULT_USER_DATA_DIR = os.path.join(HERE, '.verify-user-data')
DEFAULT_EVIDENCE_PATH = os.path.join(HERE, '.verify-persistence-evidence.json')

PERSIST_MATERIAL = '重启保留素材'
PERSIST_MATERIAL_NOTE = '重启保留笔记：降噪、音量均衡与响度一致'
PERSIST_TOPIC = '重启保留选题'
PERSIST_TOPIC_ANGLE = '重启后仍应保留的内容角度'
PERSIST_TOPIC_PRIORITY = 'high'
PERSIST_TASK_DRAFT = '重启保留草稿：三款工具的输出质量与改写能力对比'
PERSIST_TASK_STATUS = 'writing'


def first_match(page, selector):
    '''取第一个匹配元素：持久化用例复用同一 user_data_dir，历史运行可能留下同标题记录。'''
    locator = page.locator(selector).first
    locator.wait_for(timeout=5000)
    return locator


def shell_route(page):
    '''读取 shell.getRoute() 当前视图与参数（main.js 把外壳实例挂在 window.__cmsShell 上供页面验证）。'''
    return page.evaluate(
        "() => { const shell = globalThis.__cmsShell;"
        " if (!shell || typeof shell.getRoute !== 'function') return null;"
        " const route = shell.getRoute();"
        " return { view: route.view, params: route.params || {} }; }"
    )


def browser_local_dates(page):
    '''浏览器本地真实日期 D 与 D-1（与产品 toLocalISODate 的本地日期语义一致）。'''
    return page.evaluate(
        "() => { const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');"
        " const fmt = (d) => d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate());"
        " const today = new Date();"
        " const yesterday = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() - 1);"
        " return { today: fmt(today), yesterday: fmt(yesterday) }; }"
    )


def material_ids(page):
    return page.locator(SEL_ITEM).evaluate_all(
        "els => els.map(el => el.getAttribute('data-material-id'))"
    )


def material_snapshot(page):
    titles = material_titles(page)
    return {'count': len(titles), 'titles': titles, 'ids': material_ids(page)}


def topic_snapshot(page):
    titles = topic_titles(page)
    return {'count': len(titles), 'titles': titles}


def topic_fields_snapshot(page):
    return {
        'title': page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT),
        'angle': page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT),
        'priority': page.input_value(SEL_TOPICS_PRIORITY),
        'linkedMaterialIds': topic_linked_ids(page),
    }


def task_snapshot(page, topic_id):
    '''任务详情当前展示的数据：字段值 + 来源选题标题 + 来源素材 + 该选题的来源任务 ID。'''
    route = shell_route(page) or {}
    params = route.get('params') or {}
    record = find_record(
        storage_json(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY),
        lambda item: item.get('sourceTopicId') == topic_id,
    )
    return {
        'title': page.input_value(SEL_TASK_TITLE_INPUT),
        'draft': page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT),
        'due': page.input_value(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT),
        'status': page.input_value(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT),
        'sourceTopicTitle': page.inner_text(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_TOPIC_TITLE).strip(),
        'sourceMaterialIds': page.locator(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_MATERIAL_ITEM).evaluate_all(
            "els => els.map(el => el.getAttribute('data-material-id'))"
        ),
        'topicId': topic_id,
        'taskId': record['id'] if record else '',
        'routeTaskId': params.get('taskId') or '',
    }


def workbench_snapshot(page):
    return {
        'unfinishedCount': shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_COUNT),
        'overdueCount': shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_COUNT),
        'statusCounts': {
            status: shown_count(page, status_count_selector(status)) for status in WORKBENCH_STATUSES
        },
        'unfinishedTaskIds': item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_ITEM),
        'overdueTaskIds': item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_ITEM),
    }


def launch_persistent_context(playwright, user_data_dir):
    '''固定 user_data_dir 的持久化浏览器上下文（优先使用本机 Chrome，退回内置 Chromium）。'''
    os.makedirs(user_data_dir, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        return playwright.chromium.launch_persistent_context(user_data_dir, chromium_sandbox=True)
    except Exception:
        return playwright.chromium.launch_persistent_context(user_data_dir, chromium_sandbox=True)


def enter_persist_task(page, topic_id):
    '''经该选题条目内的创建任务入口进入其内容任务详情，并返回任务详情快照。'''
    first_match(page, topic_child(PERSIST_TOPIC, SEL_TOPICS_CREATE_TASK)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    return task_snapshot(page, topic_id)


def persistence_first_phase(page, report):
    '''前阶段：在传入 URL 上用页面操作保存素材、选题（含关联素材）与内容任务，并刷新核对数据仍在。'''
    product_url = page.url
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_MATERIALS_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_MATERIALS_VIEW).is_visible(), '前阶段页面应显示素材库视图 materials-view')
    dates = browser_local_dates(page)
    today = dates.get('today')
    yesterday = dates.get('yesterday')
    report.check(
        isinstance(today, str) and isinstance(yesterday, str) and today > yesterday,
        '应取得浏览器本地真实日期 D 与 D-1，实际 %r' % (dates,),
    )
    report.step('前阶段日期', 'D=%s，D-1=%s' % (today, yesterday))

    # --- 保存素材：materials-new-button → 标题／笔记 → materials-save-button ---
    materials_before = material_snapshot(page)
    page.click(SEL_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TITLE_INPUT, PERSIST_MATERIAL)
    page.fill(SEL_NOTE_INPUT, PERSIST_MATERIAL_NOTE)
    page.click(SEL_SAVE)
    first_match(page, item_selector_by_title(PERSIST_MATERIAL))
    materials_after = material_snapshot(page)
    report.check(
        materials_after['count'] == materials_before['count'] + 1,
        '保存素材后 materials-item 条数应 %d -> %d，实际 %d'
        % (materials_before['count'], materials_before['count'] + 1, materials_after['count']),
    )
    material_id = first_match(page, item_selector_by_title(PERSIST_MATERIAL)).get_attribute(MATERIAL_ID_ATTR)
    report.check(bool(material_id), '该素材应以 materials-item 出现且带 data-material-id')
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '保存素材不应显示 error-text 提示')
    report.step('前阶段保存素材', '素材条数 %d -> %d' % (materials_before['count'], materials_after['count']))

    # --- 保存选题（标题／内容角度／优先级）并关联该素材 ---
    goto_topics(page)
    topics_before = topic_snapshot(page)
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT, PERSIST_TOPIC)
    page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_ANGLE_INPUT, PERSIST_TOPIC_ANGLE)
    page.select_option(SEL_TOPICS_PRIORITY, PERSIST_TOPIC_PRIORITY)
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    first_match(page, topic_selector(PERSIST_TOPIC))
    topics_after = topic_snapshot(page)
    report.check(
        topics_after['count'] == topics_before['count'] + 1,
        '保存选题后 topics-item 条数应 %d -> %d，实际 %d'
        % (topics_before['count'], topics_before['count'] + 1, topics_after['count']),
    )
    report.check(PERSIST_TOPIC in topics_after['titles'], '新选题应以 topics-item 出现在 topics-list 中')

    first_match(page, topic_selector(PERSIST_TOPIC)).locator(SEL_TOPICS_EDIT).click()
    topic_id = first_match(page, topic_selector(PERSIST_TOPIC)).get_attribute('data-topic-id')
    report.check(bool(topic_id), '该选题条目应带 data-topic-id')
    checkbox = page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(material_id)).first
    checkbox.wait_for(timeout=5000)
    if not checkbox.is_checked():
        checkbox.check()
    page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
    first_match(page, topic_linked_selector(material_id))
    topic_fields = topic_fields_snapshot(page)
    report.check(
        topic_fields['title'] == PERSIST_TOPIC,
        '选题标题应为 %r，实际 %r' % (PERSIST_TOPIC, topic_fields['title']),
    )
    report.check(
        topic_fields['angle'] == PERSIST_TOPIC_ANGLE,
        '内容角度应为 %r，实际 %r' % (PERSIST_TOPIC_ANGLE, topic_fields['angle']),
    )
    report.check(
        topic_fields['priority'] == PERSIST_TOPIC_PRIORITY,
        '优先级应为 %r，实际 %r' % (PERSIST_TOPIC_PRIORITY, topic_fields['priority']),
    )
    report.check(
        topic_fields['linkedMaterialIds'] == [material_id],
        'topics-linked-material 的 data-material-id 应与素材库同一条素材一致，实际 %r'
        % (topic_fields['linkedMaterialIds'],),
    )
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '保存选题与关联素材不应显示 error-text 提示')
    report.step('前阶段保存选题', '选题 %r 关联素材 %r' % (PERSIST_TOPIC, material_id))

    # --- 从该选题创建内容任务并保存草稿／截止日期（D-1）／状态 ---
    first_match(page, topic_child(PERSIST_TOPIC, SEL_TOPICS_CREATE_TASK)).click()
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_TASK_DETAIL_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DRAFT_INPUT, PERSIST_TASK_DRAFT)
    page.fill(SEL_TASK_DUE_INPUT, yesterday)
    page.select_option(SEL_TASK_STATUS_SELECT, PERSIST_TASK_STATUS)
    page.click(SEL_TASK_SAVE)
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '保存任务草稿／截止日期／状态不应显示 error-text 提示')
    task = task_snapshot(page, topic_id)
    report.check(
        task['draft'] == PERSIST_TASK_DRAFT,
        '任务草稿应保存为 %r，实际 %r' % (PERSIST_TASK_DRAFT, task['draft']),
    )
    report.check(task['due'] == yesterday, '任务截止日期应保存为 D-1（%s），实际 %r' % (yesterday, task['due']))
    report.check(
        task['status'] == PERSIST_TASK_STATUS,
        '任务状态应保存为 %r，实际 %r' % (PERSIST_TASK_STATUS, task['status']),
    )
    report.check(
        task['sourceTopicTitle'] == PERSIST_TOPIC,
        'task-source-topic-title 应显示来源选题标题，实际 %r' % (task['sourceTopicTitle'],),
    )
    report.check(bool(task['taskId']), '该选题应创建出内容任务')
    report.check(
        task['routeTaskId'] == task['taskId'],
        'shell.getRoute() 应返回该任务详情与同一个 taskId，实际 %r／%r'
        % (task['routeTaskId'], task['taskId']),
    )
    report.check(material_id in task['sourceMaterialIds'], 'task-source-material-item 应包含该素材')
    task_id = task['taskId']
    report.step('前阶段保存任务', 'taskId=%s，草稿／D-1=%s／状态已保存' % (task_id, yesterday))

    # --- 工作台：未完成／逾期／四状态计数与任务数据一致 ---
    goto_workbench(page)
    check_workbench(page, report, '前阶段工作台统计')
    workbench = workbench_snapshot(page)
    total_tasks = len(storage_json(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY))
    report.check(
        sum(workbench['statusCounts'].values()) == total_tasks,
        '四状态计数之和应等于任务总数 %d，实际 %d' % (total_tasks, sum(workbench['statusCounts'].values())),
    )
    if task_id:
        report.check(task_id in workbench['unfinishedTaskIds'], '未完成任务应包含该任务')
        report.check(task_id in workbench['overdueTaskIds'], '截止日期为 D-1 的任务应计入逾期')
    report.step(
        '前阶段工作台',
        '未完成 %d／逾期 %d／任务总数 %d'
        % (workbench['unfinishedCount'], workbench['overdueCount'], total_tasks),
    )

    # --- 刷新前快照（同一持久化上下文内） ---
    goto_materials(page)
    before_materials = material_snapshot(page)
    goto_topics(page)
    before_topics = topic_snapshot(page)
    goto_workbench(page)
    before_workbench = workbench_snapshot(page)
    goto_topics(page)
    before_task = enter_persist_task(page, topic_id)

    # --- 同一持久化上下文内刷新页面（同一 URL）：数据同样保留 ---
    page.reload(wait_until='load')
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_MATERIALS_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    report.check(page.url == product_url, '刷新后应仍在同一产品 URL 上，实际 %r' % (page.url,))
    refreshed_materials = material_snapshot(page)
    report.check(
        refreshed_materials['count'] == before_materials['count']
        and refreshed_materials['titles'] == before_materials['titles'],
        '刷新后素材条数与 data-material-title 应与刷新前一致，实际 %r' % (refreshed_materials['titles'],),
    )
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '刷新后不应出现 error-text 提示')

    refreshed = {'materials': refreshed_materials}
    for selector, view_id, view_selector in (
        (SEL_NAV_MATERIALS, 'materials', SEL_MATERIALS_VIEW),
        (SEL_NAV_TOPICS, 'topics', SEL_TOPICS_VIEW),
        (SEL_NAV_WORKBENCH, 'workbench', SEL_WORKBENCH_VIEW),
    ):
        page.click(selector)
        page.wait_for_selector(view_selector, timeout=15000)
        report.check(page.locator(view_selector).is_visible(), '点击 %s 后对应视图应正常渲染' % selector)
        route = shell_route(page)
        report.check(route is not None, '应能读取 shell.getRoute()（main.js 暴露 window.__cmsShell）')
        report.check(
            bool(route) and route.get('view') == view_id,
            '点击 %s 后 shell.getRoute() 当前视图应为 %s，实际 %r' % (selector, view_id, route),
        )
        if view_id == 'materials':
            refreshed['materials'] = material_snapshot(page)
        elif view_id == 'topics':
            refreshed['topics'] = topic_snapshot(page)
        else:
            check_workbench(page, report, '刷新后工作台统计')
            refreshed['workbench'] = workbench_snapshot(page)

    report.check(refreshed['materials'] == before_materials, '刷新后素材列表应与刷新前完全一致')
    report.check(refreshed.get('topics') == before_topics, '刷新后选题列表应与刷新前完全一致')
    report.check(refreshed.get('workbench') == before_workbench, '刷新后工作台计数与条目应与刷新前完全一致')

    goto_topics(page)
    refreshed_task = enter_persist_task(page, topic_id)
    report.check(
        refreshed_task == before_task,
        '刷新后任务详情的标题／草稿／截止日期／状态／来源选题应与刷新前一致，实际 %r／期望 %r'
        % (refreshed_task, before_task),
    )
    report.step('前阶段刷新保留', '刷新后素材／选题／任务详情／工作台与刷新前一致')

    return {
        'url': product_url,
        'dates': dates,
        'material_id': material_id,
        'topic_id': topic_id,
        'task_id': task_id,
        'snapshots': {
            'materials': before_materials,
            'topics': before_topics,
            'topicFields': topic_fields,
            'task': before_task,
            'workbench': before_workbench,
        },
        'refresh': {
            'materials': refreshed['materials'],
            'topics': refreshed.get('topics'),

def run_persistence_phase(url, phase, user_data_dir, evidence_path):
    '''持久化两阶段的公共入口：phase=first 保存数据并落盘证据；phase=second 复核数据仍保留。'''
    report = Report()
    try:
        from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - 依赖缺失时明确报告
        report.problems.append('缺少 playwright 依赖: ' + str(exc))
        print(json.dumps({
            'ok': False,
            'mode': 'persistence',
            'phase': phase,
            'url': url,
            'user_data_dir': os.path.abspath(user_data_dir),
            'problems': report.problems,
            'note': '脚本不启动服务、不绑定端口、不输出 skip。',
        }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return 1

    evidence = None
    if phase == 'second':
        if not os.path.exists(evidence_path):
            report.problems.append('缺少前阶段证据文件，无法比对：' + os.path.abspath(evidence_path))
            print(json.dumps({
                'ok': False,
                'mode': 'persistence',
                'phase': phase,
                'url': url,
                'user_data_dir': os.path.abspath(user_data_dir),
                'evidence_path': os.path.abspath(evidence_path),
                'problems': report.problems,
                'note': '后阶段需要前阶段（--phase first）落盘的证据文件。',
            }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
            return 1
        try:
            with open(evidence_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
                evidence = json.load(handle)
        except Exception as exc:
            report.problems.append('读取前阶段证据文件失败: ' + str(exc))
            print(json.dumps({
                'ok': False,
                'mode': 'persistence',
                'phase': phase,
                'url': url,
                'user_data_dir': os.path.abspath(user_data_dir),
                'evidence_path': os.path.abspath(evidence_path),
                'problems': report.problems,
            }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
            return 1

    result = {}
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        context = launch_persistent_context(playwright, user_data_dir)
        try:
            page = context.pages[0] if context.pages else context.new_page()
            page.goto(url, wait_until='load')
            if phase == 'first':
                result = persistence_first_phase(page, report)
            else:
                persistence_second_phase(page, report, evidence)
        except Exception as exc:
            report.problems.append('页面操作中断: ' + type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc))
        finally:
            # 关闭持久化上下文：Chromium 在关闭时把 localStorage 落盘到 user_data_dir。
            try:
                context.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

    output = {
        'ok': not report.problems,
        'mode': 'persistence',
        'phase': phase,
        'url': url,
        'user_data_dir': os.path.abspath(user_data_dir),
        'evidence_path': os.path.abspath(evidence_path),
        'operations': report.steps,
        'problems': report.problems,
        'note': '脚本不启动服务、不绑定端口、不输出 skip；本地服务由 Worker 在两次运行之间重启。',
    }

    if phase == 'first':
        documents = {
            'phase': 'first',
            'url': result.get('url') or url,
            'user_data_dir': os.path.abspath(user_data_dir),
            'dates': result.get('dates'),
            'python_today': date.today().isoformat(),
            'operations': report.steps,
            'assertions': {'passed': not report.problems, 'problems': list(report.problems)},
            'snapshots': result.get('snapshots'),
            'refresh': result.get('refresh'),
            'material_id': result.get('material_id'),
            'topic_id': result.get('topic_id'),
            'task_id': result.get('task_id'),
        }
        try:
            with open(evidence_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
                json.dump(documents, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        except Exception as exc:
            report.problems.append('写入证据文件失败: ' + str(exc))
        output['dates'] = documents['dates']
        output['snapshots'] = documents['snapshots']
        output['refresh'] = documents['refresh']
        output['assertions'] = documents['assertions']
        output['problems'] = report.problems
        output['ok'] = not report.problems
    else:
        phase1_url = evidence.get('url')
        phase2_url = url
        phase1_dir = evidence.get('user_data_dir')
        phase2_dir = os.path.abspath(user_data_dir)
        url_matches = phase1_url == phase2_url
        dir_matches = phase1_dir == phase2_dir
        phase1_assertions = evidence.get('assertions') or {}
        report.check(
            evidence.get('phase') == 'first',
            '前阶段证据应来自 --phase first 运行，实际 %r' % (evidence.get('phase'),),
        )
        report.check(url_matches, '两次运行的 URL 应一致，前阶段 %r／后阶段 %r' % (phase1_url, phase2_url))
        report.check(
            dir_matches,
            '两次运行的 user_data_dir 应一致，前阶段 %r／后阶段 %r' % (phase1_dir, phase2_dir),
        )
        report.check(
            bool(phase1_assertions.get('passed')),
            '前阶段证据自身的关键断言应全部通过，否则后阶段比对不可信：%r' % (phase1_assertions.get('problems'),),
        )
        comparison = {
            'phase1_url': phase1_url,
            'phase2_url': phase2_url,
            'url_matches': url_matches,
            'phase1_user_data_dir': phase1_dir,
            'phase2_user_data_dir': phase2_dir,
            'user_data_dir_matches': dir_matches,
            'phase1_dates': evidence.get('dates'),
            'phase1_assertions_passed': bool(phase1_assertions.get('passed')),
            'conclusion': (
                '两次运行使用同一 URL 与同一 user_data_dir，服务重启后重新打开页面时素材、选题与任务数据仍在'
                if url_matches and dir_matches and phase1_assertions.get('passed')
                else '两次运行的 URL／user_data_dir 或前阶段断言不一致，不能据此判定重启后数据保留'
            ),
        }
        output['comparison'] = comparison
        output['problems'] = report.problems
        output['ok'] = not report.problems

    print(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0 if output['ok'] else 1


def verify(url):
    report = Report()
    try:
        from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - 依赖缺失时明确报告
        report.problems.append('缺少 playwright 依赖: ' + str(exc))
        return report

    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = launch_browser(playwright)
        context = browser.new_context()
        # 来源链接目标为外部地址：拦截该地址的请求，使点击真实发生且不依赖外网。
        context.route(
            '**/example.com/**',
            lambda route: route.fulfill(
                status=200,
                content_type='text/html',
                body='<html><body>source-link-open</body></html>',
            ),
        )
        page = context.new_page()
        page_requests = []
        page.on('request', lambda request: page_requests.append(request.url))
        # 真实 console 错误监听：不隐藏、不过滤，favicon 图标加载失败同样计入。
        console_errors = []

        def handle_console(message):
            if message.type == 'error':
                location = message.location or {}
                where = location.get('url') or ''
                console_errors.append(message.text if not where else '%s (%s)' % (message.text, where))

        page.on('console', handle_console)
        page.on('pageerror', lambda error: console_errors.append('pageerror: ' + str(error)))
        # 浏览器原生对话框：按当前策略接受／取消，并记录文本供断言。
        # 删除未关联素材与删除未建任务的选题不应出现任何对话框；删除已关联素材先出现影响提示。
        dialogs = []
        dialog_state = {'mode': 'dismiss'}

        def handle_dialog(dialog):
            dialogs.append(dialog.message)
            if dialog_state['mode'] == 'accept':
                dialog.accept()
            else:
                dialog.dismiss()

        page.on('dialog', handle_dialog)
        try:
            page.goto(url, wait_until='load')
            material_id = materials_flow(page, context, report, page_requests)
            topics_flow(page, context, report, dialogs, material_id)
            tasks_flow(page, report)
            delete_and_block_flow(page, report, dialogs, dialog_state)
            if console_errors:
                report.problems.append(
                    '页面加载与操作期间不应出现 console 错误（不隐藏、不过滤 favicon 等图标错误），实际: %r'
                    % (console_errors,)
                )
            else:
                report.steps.append(
                    '页面图标：装配后文档声明 rel=icon，浏览器新上下文加载与操作期间 console 错误数为 0'
                )
            favicon_requests = [item for item in page_requests if 'favicon' in item]
            if favicon_requests:
                report.problems.append('页面仍请求产品目录中不存在的图标文件: %r' % (favicon_requests,))
        except Exception as exc:
            report.problems.append('页面操作中断: ' + type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc))
        finally:
            context.close()
            browser.close()
    return report

    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    if not url:
        print(json.dumps({

    """保留原全部断言，并通过真实页面验证多选题删除与任务详情。"""
    report = _cross_module_original_verify(url)
    from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(chromium_sandbox=True)
        page = browser.new_page()
        errors = []
        page.on('pageerror', lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
        page.on('console', lambda message: errors.append(message.text) if message.type == 'error' else None)
        page.goto(url)
        for title in ['跨模块共同素材', '跨模块保留素材']:
            goto_materials(page)
            page.click(SEL_NEW)
            page.fill(SEL_TITLE_INPUT, title)
            page.click(SEL_SAVE)
        records = storage_json(page, MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY)
        doomed = next(item['id'] for item in records if item['title'] == '跨模块共同素材')
        kept = next(item['id'] for item in records if item['title'] == '跨模块保留素材')
        for title in ['跨模块选题甲', '跨模块选题乙']:
            goto_topics(page)
            page.click(SEL_TOPICS_NEW)
            page.fill(SEL_TOPICS_TITLE_INPUT, title)
            page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
            open_topic(page, title)
            page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(doomed)).check()
            page.locator(topic_checkbox_selector(kept)).check()
            page.click(SEL_TOPICS_SAVE)
            open_task_from_topic(page, title)
            report.check(page.locator(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_MATERIAL_ITEM).count() == 2, '删除前任务详情应显示两个素材')
        report.step('跨模块准备', '两个素材、两个选题、两个任务，经页面操作创建')
        goto_workbench(page)
        counts_before = workbench_counts(page)
        before = [collection_raw(page, key) for key in [MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY]]
        goto_materials(page)
        messages = []

        def cancel(dialog):
            """记录原生确认的影响文本，并取消删除。"""
            messages.append(dialog.message)
            dialog.dismiss()

        page.on('dialog', cancel)
        page.locator(item_selector(doomed)).locator(SEL_MATERIALS_DELETE).click()
        page.remove_listener('dialog', cancel)
        report.check(messages and '跨模块选题甲' in messages[0] and '跨模块选题乙' in messages[0], '影响提示应包含两个选题')
        report.check([collection_raw(page, key) for key in [MATERIALS_STORAGE_KEY, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY]] == before, '取消删除后全部数据不变')
        report.step('跨模块取消删除', '影响提示包含两个选题，取消后数据不变')

        def accept(dialog):
            """确认同一素材删除，让实际编排清理关联。"""
            dialog.accept()

        page.on('dialog', accept)
        page.locator(item_selector(doomed)).locator(SEL_MATERIALS_DELETE).click()
        page.remove_listener('dialog', accept)
        report.check(page.locator(item_selector(doomed)).count() == 0, '确认后素材消失')
        for title in ['跨模块选题甲', '跨模块选题乙']:
            topic = next(item for item in storage_json(page, TOPICS_STORAGE_KEY) if item['title'] == title)
            report.check(topic['materialIds'] == [kept], '两个选题都应仅保留剩余素材关联')
            open_task_from_topic(page, title)
            actual = page.locator(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_MATERIAL_ITEM).evaluate_all('els => els.map(el => el.getAttribute("data-material-id"))')
            report.check(actual == [kept], '两个任务详情都应显示保留素材')
        report.check(collection_raw(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY) == before[2], '删除素材不能修改内容任务')
        report.step('跨模块确认删除', '全部关联清理，任务保留且显示剩余素材')
        page.reload()
        for title in ['跨模块选题甲', '跨模块选题乙']:
            open_task_from_topic(page, title)
            actual = page.locator(SEL_TASK_SOURCE_MATERIAL_ITEM).evaluate_all('els => els.map(el => el.getAttribute("data-material-id"))')
            report.check(actual == [kept], '刷新后任务详情仍显示剩余素材')
        report.step('跨模块刷新', '关联和任务详情保持')
        goto_workbench(page)
        report.check(workbench_counts(page) == counts_before, '素材删除后工作台计数不变')
        report.check(not errors, '跨模块操作没有页面或控制台错误：' + str(errors))
        report.step('跨模块正常使用', '工作台统计不变，页面和控制台无异常')
        browser.close()
    return report


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
'''产品验证入口（真实浏览器）：在 Worker 传入的当前产品 URL 上按 data-testid 执行页面操作。

用法：
    python verify_product.py <URL>
    python verify_product.py --url <URL>

契约：脚本不启动 HTTP 服务、不绑定端口、不输出 skip；只连接传入的 URL，执行真实页面操作并断言结果。

覆盖四个已交付页面切片：
  1) 素材库页面：新增、查看、编辑、关键词检索、来源链接打开、标题留空保存失败后补标题。
  2) 选题管理页面：进入选题管理、新增选题（默认优先级／可空内容角度）、查看并编辑选题、
     关联与解除关联素材（含多对多）、标题留空保存失败并保留已填内容、补标题后保存成功、
     删除未建内容任务的选题（不出现任何确认、关联消失、素材保留）。
  3) 内容任务与工作台：从选题创建内容任务（重复创建进入同一个任务）、任务详情展示与编辑
     标题／草稿／截止日期、四态切换（含从已发布回退）、清空标题保存失败并断言草稿保留、
     恢复标题后保存成功、工作台未完成／逾期条目与四状态计数、点击工作台条目进入任务详情、
     清空截止日期或设为当天后不计入逾期、改为已发布后从工作台移除、刷新页面后数据与计数保留。
  4) 素材删除与「删除已创建任务的选题被阻止」：删除未关联素材不出现任何确认；
     删除已关联素材先出现含素材标题与受影响选题标题的影响提示，取消后素材／关联／任务与工作台计数零变化，
     确认后素材与全部关联被删除、相关选题保留，随后打开该选题创建的任务详情仍显示来源选题与当前关联素材；
     删除已创建任务的选题被阻止并说明原因，随后素材库／选题管理／工作台可正常使用且数据不变；
     编辑选题的内容角度与优先级后其他任务与其他素材内容不变。

持久化两阶段（A039，本地服务由 Worker 在两次运行之间重启，脚本不参与服务进程管理、不自建服务、不绑定端口）：
    python verify_product.py --phase first  --user-data-dir <DIR> --evidence <FILE> <URL>
    # Worker 重启本地服务

  前阶段：用固定 user_data_dir 的持久化浏览器上下文（channel=chrome）在传入的当前 URL 上执行真实页面操作
  （保存素材、保存选题并关联该素材、从该选题创建内容任务并保存草稿／截止日期／状态），随后在同一持久化上下文内
  刷新页面并复核，最后把证据落盘（实际 URL、user_data_dir、D 与 D-1 的真实日期、操作序列、关键断言结果与快照）。

class Report:
    def __init__(self):
        self.problems = []
        self.steps = []

    def check(self, condition, message):
        if not condition:
            self.problems.append(message)
        return bool(condition)

    def step(self, name, detail=''):
        self.steps.append(name + ('：' + detail if detail else ''))


def item_selector(material_id):
    return '%s[%s="%s"]' % (SEL_ITEM, MATERIAL_ID_ATTR, material_id)


def item_selector_by_title(title):
    return '%s[%s="%s"]' % (SEL_ITEM, TITLE_ATTR, title.replace('"', '\\"'))


def topic_selector(title):
    return '%s[%s="%s"]' % (SEL_TOPICS_ITEM, TOPIC_TITLE_ATTR, title.replace('"', '\\"'))


def topic_child(title, child_selector):
    return '%s %s' % (topic_selector(title), child_selector)


def topic_checkbox_selector(material_id):
    return '%s[%s="%s"]' % (SEL_TOPICS_CHECKBOX, MATERIAL_ID_ATTR, material_id)


def topic_linked_selector(material_id):

def storage_json(page, key):
    '''读取页面 localStorage 中的集合（仅用于交叉核对数量与记录，不代替页面操作）。'''
    raw = page.evaluate('(k) => localStorage.getItem(k)', key)
    if not raw:
        return []
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        return []
    return parsed if isinstance(parsed, list) else []


def local_today(page):
    '''在浏览器上下文中取本地当天（与产品内部 toLocalISODate 使用同一时区）。'''
    return page.evaluate(
        "() => { const d = new Date();"
        " const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');"
        " return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate()); }"
    )


def find_record(records, predicate):
    for record in records:
        if isinstance(record, dict) and predicate(record):
            return record
    return None


def shown_count(page, selector):
    try:
        return int(page.inner_text(selector).strip())
    except Exception:
        return -1

def item_task_ids(page, item_selector):

        "els => els.map(el => el.getAttribute('data-task-id'))"
    )


def expected_summary(page):
    '''按任务当前数据推出工作台应显示的值。'''
    today = local_today(page)
    tasks = storage_json(page, TASKS_STORAGE_KEY)
    unfinished = [task for task in tasks if task.get('status') != 'published']
    overdue = [
        task for task in unfinished
        if task.get('dueDate') and task['dueDate'] < today
    ]
    counts = {
        status: len([task for task in tasks if task.get('status') == status])
        for status in WORKBENCH_STATUSES
    }
    return today, tasks, unfinished, overdue, counts


def check_workbench(page, report, step_name):
    '''断言工作台当前展示与任务数据一致，并返回期望值供后续步骤比较。'''
    today, tasks, unfinished, overdue, counts = expected_summary(page)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_WORKBENCH_VIEW).is_visible(), '工作台视图应可见')
    shown_unfinished = shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_COUNT)
    shown_overdue = shown_count(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_COUNT)
    report.check(
        shown_unfinished == len(unfinished),
        '未完成计数应为 %d，实际 %d' % (len(unfinished), shown_unfinished),
    )
    report.check(
        shown_overdue == len(overdue),
        '逾期计数应为 %d，实际 %d' % (len(overdue), shown_overdue),
    )

    by_id = {task.get('id'): task for task in tasks if isinstance(task, dict)}
    unfinished_ids = item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_UNFINISHED_ITEM)
    report.check(
        sorted(unfinished_ids) == sorted(task['id'] for task in unfinished),
        '未完成条目应与未完成任务集合一致，实际 %r' % (unfinished_ids,),
    )
    for task_id in unfinished_ids:
        record = by_id.get(task_id, {})
        report.check(record.get('status') != 'published', '未完成条目不包含已发布任务：' + str(task_id))

    overdue_ids = item_task_ids(page, SEL_WORKBENCH_OVERDUE_ITEM)
    report.check(
        sorted(overdue_ids) == sorted(task['id'] for task in overdue),
        '逾期条目应与逾期任务集合一致，实际 %r' % (overdue_ids,),
    )
    for task_id in overdue_ids:
        record = by_id.get(task_id, {})
        report.check(record.get('status') != 'published', '逾期条目不包含已发布任务：' + str(task_id))
        report.check(
            bool(record.get('dueDate')) and record['dueDate'] < today,
            '逾期条目应有早于本地当天的截止日期：' + str(task_id),
        )

    total = 0
    for status in WORKBENCH_STATUSES:
        shown = shown_count(page, status_count_selector(status))
        report.check(
            shown == counts[status],
            '%s 状态计数应为 %d，实际 %d' % (status, counts[status], shown),
        )
        total += shown
    report.check(
        total == len(tasks),
        '四状态计数之和应等于任务总数 %d，实际 %d' % (len(tasks), total),
    )
    report.check(
        all(task.get('status') != 'published' for task in overdue),
        '逾期任务都应属于未完成任务',
    )
    report.step(step_name, '未完成 %d／逾期 %d／任务总数 %d' % (len(unfinished), len(overdue), len(tasks)))
    return today, tasks, unfinished, overdue


def launch_browser(playwright):
    try:
        return playwright.chromium.launch(chromium_sandbox=True)
    except Exception:
        return playwright.chromium.launch(chromium_sandbox=True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 素材库页面流程：返回本次用于选题关联的素材 ID。
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def materials_flow(page, context, report, page_requests):
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_MATERIALS_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_MATERIALS_VIEW).is_visible(), '页面应显示素材库视图根 materials-view')
    title_text = page.inner_text(SEL_VIEW_TITLE).strip()
    report.check(title_text == VIEW_TITLE_MATERIALS, '视图标题应为 %s，实际 %r' % (VIEW_TITLE_MATERIALS, title_text))
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_ERROR).count() == 1, 'error-text 定位点应唯一')
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '初始页面不应显示错误提示')
    report.step('页面入口', 'materials-view / view-title / error-text 就绪')

    # --- A001 新增素材 ------------------------------------------------------
    before = page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()
    page.click(SEL_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TITLE_INPUT, MATERIAL_A)
    page.click(SEL_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(item_selector_by_title(MATERIAL_A), timeout=5000)
    after = page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()
    report.check(after == before + 1, '新增素材后列表数量应 %d -> %d，实际 %d' % (before, before + 1, after))
    report.check(page.locator(item_selector_by_title(MATERIAL_A)).count() == 1, '新素材应出现在 materials-list 中')
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '新增成功后不应显示 error-text')
    report.step('A001 新增素材', '列表数量 %d -> %d' % (before, after))

    # --- A002 只填标题、来源链接留空（含刷新后仍为空） -----------------------
    page.click(SEL_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TITLE_INPUT, MATERIAL_B)
    page.click(SEL_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(item_selector_by_title(MATERIAL_B), timeout=5000)
    open_material(page, MATERIAL_B)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_SOURCE_INPUT) == '', '未填来源链接的素材打开后来源链接应为空字符串')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TITLE_INPUT) == MATERIAL_B, '打开素材应预填标题')
    page.reload(wait_until='load')
    page.wait_for_selector(SEL_MATERIALS_VIEW, timeout=15000)
    report.check(page.locator(item_selector_by_title(MATERIAL_B)).count() == 1, '刷新后素材应仍在列表中（持久化）')
    open_material(page, MATERIAL_B)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_SOURCE_INPUT) == '', '刷新后来源链接仍应为空字符串')
    report.step('A002 只填标题', '素材保存成功且来源链接为空')

    # --- A003 查看已有素材：预填三个字段 ------------------------------------
    page.click(SEL_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_TITLE_INPUT, MATERIAL_C)
    page.fill(SEL_SOURCE_INPUT, SOURCE_URL)
    page.fill(SEL_NOTE_INPUT, '冷色转场参考')
    page.click(SEL_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(item_selector_by_title(MATERIAL_C), timeout=5000)
    open_material(page, MATERIAL_C)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TITLE_INPUT) == MATERIAL_C, '查看素材应预填标题')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_SOURCE_INPUT) == SOURCE_URL, '查看素材应预填来源链接')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_NOTE_INPUT) == '冷色转场参考', '查看素材应预填笔记')
    report.step('A003 查看素材', '标题／来源链接／笔记均预填')

    # --- A004 来源链接是真实可点击链接，且页面不抓取该地址内容 --------------
    item = page.locator(item_selector_by_title(MATERIAL_C))
    material_id = item.get_attribute(MATERIAL_ID_ATTR)
    report.check(isinstance(material_id, str) and material_id != '', '素材条目应带 data-material-id')
    link = item.locator(SEL_SOURCE_LINK)
    report.check(link.count() == 1, '来源链接应渲染为链接元素')
    if link.count() == 1:
        report.check(link.get_attribute('href') == SOURCE_URL, '链接 href 应与保存的来源链接完全一致')
        report.check(not any('example.com' in url for url in page_requests), '点击前页面不应抓取来源链接内容')
        product_url = page.url
        with context.expect_page() as popup_info:
            link.click()
        popup = popup_info.value
        popup.wait_for_url(SOURCE_URL, timeout=10000)
        report.check(popup.url == SOURCE_URL, '点击来源链接应打开该地址，实际 %r' % popup.url)
        popup.close()
        report.check(page.url == product_url, '打开来源链接不应把产品页面导航离开')
        report.step('A004 来源链接', 'href 一致且点击后打开该地址')

    # --- A005 编辑笔记与标题后重新打开 -------------------------------------
    open_material(page, MATERIAL_A)
    page.fill(SEL_NOTE_INPUT, EDITED_NOTE)
    page.fill(SEL_TITLE_INPUT, EDITED_TITLE)
    page.click(SEL_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(item_selector_by_title(EDITED_TITLE), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(item_selector_by_title(MATERIAL_A)).count() == 0, '修改标题后列表应显示新标题')
    open_material(page, EDITED_TITLE)
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_NOTE_INPUT) == EDITED_NOTE, '重新打开应看到修改后的笔记')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_TITLE_INPUT) == EDITED_TITLE, '重新打开应看到修改后的标题')
    report.step('A005 编辑素材', '笔记与标题修改后可见')

    # --- A006/A007/A008 检索 ----------------------------------------------
    page.click(SEL_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_SEARCH, '   ')
    total = page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()
    expected_order = [EDITED_TITLE, MATERIAL_B, MATERIAL_C]
    report.check(total == len(expected_order), '全空白关键词应显示全部素材，实际 %d' % total)
    report.check(item_titles(page) == expected_order, '空白关键词应按存储顺序显示全部素材')
    page.fill(SEL_SEARCH, '')
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count() == total, '清空关键词应显示全部素材')

    page.fill(SEL_SEARCH, '剪辑')
    hits = page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()
    report.check(hits == 1, '关键词「剪辑」应只命中 1 条素材，实际 %d' % hits)
    report.check(page.locator(item_selector_by_title(MATERIAL_C)).count() == 1, '关键词「剪辑」应命中标题含该词的素材')
    for text in page.locator(SEL_ITEM).all_inner_texts():
        report.check('剪辑' in text, '检索结果条目应包含关键词「剪辑」')
    report.step('A006 标题检索', '「剪辑」命中 %d 条' % hits)

    page.fill(SEL_SEARCH, '降噪')
    report.check(page.locator(item_selector_by_title(EDITED_TITLE)).count() == 1, '关键词只出现在笔记也应命中该素材')
    report.step('A006 笔记检索', '「降噪」命中笔记含该词的素材')

    page.fill(SEL_SEARCH, 'ai')
    report.check(
        page.locator(item_selector_by_title(EDITED_TITLE)).count() == 1,
        '小写关键词「ai」应命中标题含「AI」的素材',
    )
    report.check(page.locator(item_selector_by_title(MATERIAL_C)).count() == 0, '不含该关键词的素材不应出现在结果中')
    report.step('A008 大小写不敏感', '小写「ai」命中「AI」素材')

    page.fill(SEL_SEARCH, '   ')
    report.check(item_titles(page) == expected_order, '再次清空关键词后应恢复全部素材与存储顺序')
    report.step('A007 空关键词', '空白关键词显示 %d 条全部素材' % total)

    # --- A043 标题必填失败并保留已填内容 -----------------------------------
    page.click(SEL_NEW)
    page.fill(SEL_NOTE_INPUT, KEPT_NOTE)
    count_before = page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count()
    page.click(SEL_SAVE)
    report.check(page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '标题留空保存应显示 error-text 提示')
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count() == count_before, '保存失败不应新增素材')
    report.check(page.input_value(SEL_NOTE_INPUT) == KEPT_NOTE, '保存失败后已填写的笔记应保留')
    report.check('标题' in page.inner_text(SEL_ERROR), '错误提示应说明标题必填')
    empty_titled = page.locator('%s[%s=""]' % (SEL_ITEM, TITLE_ATTR)).count()
    report.check(empty_titled == 0, '列表中不应出现空标题素材')
    report.step('A043 标题必填', '失败提示出现且笔记保留')

    # --- A044 补上标题后再次保存 -------------------------------------------
    page.fill(SEL_TITLE_INPUT, RECOVERED_TITLE)
    page.click(SEL_SAVE)
    page.wait_for_selector(item_selector_by_title(RECOVERED_TITLE), timeout=5000)
    report.check(page.locator(SEL_ITEM).count() == count_before + 1, '补上标题后应保存成功并出现在列表中')
    report.check(not page.is_visible(SEL_ERROR), '保存成功后不应再显示错误提示')
    report.step('A044 失败后补标题', '列表数量 %d -> %d' % (count_before, count_before + 1))

    # --- 导航回素材库仍显示该视图 ------------------------------------------
    goto_materials(page)
    report.check(page.is_visible(SEL_MATERIALS_VIEW), '经导航回素材库后应仍显示素材库视图')
    report.step('导航', 'nav-materials 后素材库视图可见')
    return material_id
